notes: Re-verified and updated: Ngurra Maga, the SKA-Low telescope's central processing facility on Wajarri Yamaji Country (Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory precinct), was officially opened in June 2026 per the WA Governor's office and SKAO; it houses the on-site supercomputing and signal-processing systems for telescope data. Scientific/astronomical data-processing facility, not commercial colocation; no public MW capacity.
